sys_script_include.description: Resolves the provider (local script include, REST message or IntegrationHub spoke) that serves an aggregate (party, policy, product, rating, claims, sanctions, geocode, document) from x_gegis_ins_policy_integration_provider. Domain code asks the registry, never a concrete class: dependency inversion so any aggregate can live in an external system.
sys_script_include.name: IntegrationRegistry
